notes: A. James Clark School of Engineering official Fall 2026 Cyber-Physical Systems Engineering graduation plan. Gen Ed slots are left out: only the program's own requirements are audited here (they're covered by gen-ed-2026-27.ts). The plan's own Year 1/Year 2 grid is a blank template (students complete these terms before Shady Grove admission, at College Park or elsewhere), so Years 1-2 here are constructed from the plan's own 'Major Requirements' side panel (Basic Sciences, Engineering Sciences, Programming Course) rather than copied from a term-by-term grid.

The Programming Requirement (ENEE140, CMSC131, CMSC106, or CMSC141) is filled with CMSC131, as commonly taken at College Park before transfer; any qualifying course would satisfy the requirement equally.
The 'MATH246/241/240' slot is filled with MATH241 (Calculus III); any of the three would satisfy the requirement equally.

Track choice: Hardware Track. The plan's four generic 'ENEB 4XX' Year 4 Spring slots are filled with the track's required course (ENEB455) plus three more electives (ENEB443, ENEB451, ENEB452); combined with ENEB352 (Year 3 Spring, a prerequisite for ENEB451), that's the track's required 4 electives. Any four electives from the pool would satisfy the requirement equally.
